Intelligence to Impact

Intelligence is everywhere. What matters is what we make possible with it. How we make a difference

Enabling our clients and society to move confidently into the digital future.

Sustainability

NTT DATA is recognized among the world's top 1% of IT service providers for sustainability. We see sustainability as a driver of long-term business value, helping organizations balance growth and responsibility. Guided by our net-zero ambitions, we turn long-term commitments into measurable action and meaningful impact for people, society and the planet.

Inclusion and Belonging

We believe organizational success is sustained when different perspectives, experiences and ideas come together. We place great importance on trust and safety and encourage a culture where all people feel respected and able to grow and contribute fully.

Leadership with a vision

Representative Director, President and Chief Executive Officer, NTT DATA Group Corporation
"Businesses and societies around the world are experiencing profound transformation driven by advances in AI and other technologies. Yet one thing remains unchanged: our commitment to staying close to our clients and delivering outcomes with accountability. By combining deep industry expertise with end-to-end capabilities spanning consulting, transformation delivery, and operations, NTT DATA enables clients to turn transformation into tangible results. AI is an important enabler of this journey. We are committed to turning knowledge and technology into real business outcomes and social value, helping our clients achieve lasting success."
